Marta: Quickfire — if your keyboard could talk, give its one-line motto or pickup line. One-liners only. Go! :keyboard: :sparkles:
Ava: 'Type less, dream more.' :zzz:
Liam: 'I press backspace for emotional support.' :wink:
Priya: 'I know your typos better than you do.' :sweat_smile:
Sam: 'Swipe right if you like mechanical clicks.' :heart_eyes:
Devin: '@Sam obviously: "Clack now, ask questions later."' :thumbsup:
Alex: 'I autocorrect your bad decisions.' :grimacing:
Ava: 'Also: I hold grudges (sticky keys).' :see_no_evil:
Liam: 'Pro tip: press `Ctrl+S` — I appreciate the praise.' :raised_hands:
Priya: "I'm fluent in three languages: QWERTY, emojis, and panic typing." :rocket:
Sam: 'Built-in sarcasm mode: `fn + sarcasm` (sold separately).' :rofl:
Devin: 'If I could talk louder, I'd clack at 6am to wake you up.' :alarm_clock:
CoffeeBot: ':coffee: Delivered. Your keyboard says thanks.'
Marta: 'Okay this was gold. New Slack status: "Keyboard whisperer"' :tada:
Alex: 'GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/keyboard-clack-3orieV0z1xjXk'
Priya: 'Winner for best one-liner: @Liam (backspace therapy).' :trophy:
